final: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS value FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.value) AS average_excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.value
